tools.name: get_methodiq_tool_guide
tools.description: Explain how to use MethodIQ Tools or one connected specialist in the user's language, including what to provide, the interaction steps, example requests, outputs and limits. Check tools/list for live availability.

tools.name: list_methodiq_tools

Discover the live Diagram, Chart, Survey Visualization, PowerPoint, Analysis, Editor and ResearchPilot categories, user guidance, examples, exact schemas and required inputs. Users do not need to know function names.

tools.description: Show the actual connected tool directory in an interactive panel. Includes required materials, schema details and a button asking host AI to prepare the selected tool input; does not execute analyses automatically.

tools.name: create_diagram

tools.name: render_diagram_editor

tools.name: set_diagram_selection

tools.name: submit_diagram_feedback

tools.name: undo_diagram

tools.name: extract_focus_graph

tools.name: trace_path

tools.name: import_pptx

tools.name: submit_deck_feedback
tools.description: submit deck feedback. Updates require the current revision; read the deck before applying user feedback.

tools.name: export_deck
tools.description: Export the current deck as a downloadable PPTX. Return the downloadUrl as a clickable link to the user. The private link expires in 10 minutes; export again if expired. Anyone with the link can download until expiry. No permanent ChatGPT file attachment is implied.

tools.name: render_pptx_editor
tools.description: render pptx editor. Updates require the current revision; read the deck before applying user feedback.

tools.name: list_capabilities
tools.description: List PPTX tool capabilities.

tools.name: get_renderer_status
tools.description: Check whether server-side PPTX compatibility rendering is available. This does not claim Microsoft PowerPoint fidelity.

tools.name: render_deck
tools.description: Render 1-10 selected slides as PNG images for visual inspection. Uses a compatibility renderer; Microsoft PowerPoint remains authoritative.

tools.name: get_pptx_workspace_status
tools.description: Check whether the owner's PPTX document workspace is available and backed by configured persistent storage.

tools.name: save_pptx_document
tools.description: Save an uploaded PPTX once in the owner's MCP workspace and return a documentId for later reads and edits.

tools.name: list_pptx_documents
tools.description: List PPTX documents saved in the owner's MCP workspace. File content is not returned.

tools.name: get_pptx_document
tools.description: Read metadata for one saved PPTX document.

tools.name: read_pptx_part
tools.description: Read structured text boxes from 1-10 selected slides without uploading the PPTX again.

tools.name: render_pptx_part
tools.description: Render 1-10 slides from a saved PPTX document as PNG images for visual review.

tools.name: apply_pptx_patch

tools.name: sync_pptx_document
tools.description: Store a human-edited PPTX as the next revision of an existing workspace document.

tools.name: export_pptx_document
tools.description: Export the current revision of a saved PPTX document as a private download.

tools.name: delete_pptx_document
tools.description: Permanently delete a saved PPTX document and all of its revisions from the owner's workspace.

tools.name: validate_slide_plan
tools.description: Validate a neutral slide plan.

tools.name: summarize_slide_plan
tools.description: Summarize deck size, warnings, and readiness.

tools.name: create_pptx_from_outline
tools.description: Create a downloadable PPTX file from a slide outline.

tools.name: analysis_estimate_propensity_scores
tools.description: Fit standardized L2-logistic propensity scores from pre-treatment numeric covariates. Not causal identification.

tools.name: analysis_diagnose_covariate_balance
tools.description: Report standardized mean differences using pooled within-group SD. Not a hypothesis or causal test.

tools.name: analysis_match_propensity_scores
tools.description: Optimal 1:1 no-replacement matching under a logit-SD caliper, before/after balance, unmatched records; no causal SE.

tools.name: analysis_fit_pls_regression
tools.description: PLS1/PLS2 regression with fixed components and fold-local scaling. NOT PLS-SEM. Independent rows only.

tools.name: analysis_analyze_correspondence
tools.description: Exploratory simple correspondence analysis of integer contingency counts, inertia and row/column coordinates.

tools.name: analysis_test_variance_homogeneity
tools.description: Median-centered Levene/Brown-Forsythe equal-variance test. NOT measurement invariance or equivalence.

tools.name: analysis_audit_reported_statistics
tools.description: Recompute exact p from supplied t/F/chi-square and df, flag numerical disagreement. NOT data or study validation.

tools.name: analysis_test_mean_equivalence
tools.description: TOST mean equivalence, independent Welch or paired t. User must specify equivalence bounds in original outcome units. NOT nonsignificance or equal variances.

tools.name: analysis_get_special_analysis_guide
tools.description: Read methods, examples, assumptions and limitations before analysis.

tools.name: analysis_get_classroom_demo_catalog
tools.description: Read the three Korean classroom demo scenarios, variables, questions and learning points before running a demo.

tools.name: analysis_run_classroom_demo
tools.description: Run a reproducible synthetic-data classroom analysis and return results, interpretation, checks and follow-up questions for the AI host to explain.

tools.name: researchpilot_open_workspace
tools.description: Open the interactive ResearchPilot workspace when the user wants to select a project, inspect method capability, review research context, or edit an instruction before continuing in the host AI conversation.

tools.name: researchpilot_capabilities
tools.description: Read canonical ResearchPilot capability authority. Use this before claiming that ResearchPilot can directly execute a research method.

tools.name: researchpilot_check_method
tools.description: Check one ResearchPilot capability by canonical capability ID and distinguish discussion/planning, direct execution, certified core, registered engine, and specialist handoff.

tools.name: researchpilot_search_literature
tools.description: Search research literature through ResearchPilot's OpenAlex/Crossref adapter. Bibliographic verification is not scientific-quality or full-text verification.

tools.name: researchpilot_search_datasets
tools.description: Search ResearchPilot dataset/data-paper providers with explicit provider availability states. Returned records remain source candidates, not automatic dataset-fit approval.

tools.name: researchpilot_research_registry
tools.description: Search ResearchPilot's unified method/model, source-provider, official-reference, or planned-plugin registry. Planning/discovery only; registry presence never authorizes execution or collection.

tools.name: researchpilot_build_collection_recipe
tools.description: Build a reproducible collection plan for YouTube metadata, web text, legal references, data APIs, or a bounded text corpus. This returns a plan only and never claims collection occurred.

tools.name: researchpilot_content_analysis_template
tools.description: Create a bounded content-analysis codebook and validation skeleton with sampling/coding/context units, category contracts, pilot coding and human/AI validation requirements. Categories remain researcher proposals.

tools.name: researchpilot_text_analysis_pilot
tools.description: Create a bounded text-analysis pilot package: collection recipe, codebook skeleton, corpus manifest, pilot/validation plan, AG-UI state, and specialist handoff route. Design only; no coding or validation is claimed.

tools.name: researchpilot_handoff_summary
tools.description: Validate the outer ResearchPilot specialist handoff identity and return a bounded context summary without source bodies. Use the original handoff package as the authority.

tools.name: researchpilot_handoff_context
tools.description: Read the immutable ResearchContext snapshot carried by a ResearchPilot handoff, including an evidence catalog without source bodies. This does not mutate Studio state or authorize execution.

tools.name: researchpilot_read_handoff_evidence
tools.description: Read one exact evidence page from a ResearchPilot handoff after verifying the outer source digest against the immutable ResearchContext snapshot.

tools.name: researchpilot_get_profile
tools.description: Return the authenticated ResearchPilot user profile for the current OAuth connection. Use only for user identity/personalization, not as research evidence.

tools.name: researchpilot_list_projects
tools.description: List the authenticated user's active ResearchPilot projects, newest first. Use before choosing a project when the user's phrase such as 'my study' is ambiguous.

tools.name: researchpilot_get_project_context
tools.description: Read one authenticated user's cloud ResearchPilot project state: research question, decisions, analysis/result summaries, stale state, source identities/digests and local-artifact availability. Raw local research files are intentionally absent.

tools.name: researchpilot_get_user_memory
tools.description: Read the authenticated user's ResearchPilot working preferences and bounded routing history. These are workflow/presentation signals, never scientific authority.

tools.name: researchpilot_update_user_preferences
tools.description: Update bounded ResearchPilot working/writing preferences only when the user explicitly states a stable preference. These preferences affect presentation/workflow, never scientific authority or method validity.

tools.name: researchpilot_record_routing_feedback
tools.description: Record explicit user feedback about a ResearchPilot capability/tool outcome. Call only when the user explicitly accepts, rejects, corrects, or reports failure/success. Do not store the user's full research question or source text.

tools.name: researchpilot_list_work_artifacts
tools.description: List saved working artifacts for one authenticated ResearchPilot project. Use this to continue prior host-AI plans, interpretations, critiques, or drafts without treating them as researcher-approved canonical decisions.

tools.name: researchpilot_read_work_artifact
tools.description: Read one saved working artifact after verifying that both project and artifact belong to the authenticated ResearchPilot owner.

tools.name: researchpilot_prepare_specialist_execution
tools.description: Prepare a rigorous specialist execution request bound to the authenticated project, exact ResearchContext digest, capability authority, and input artifact digests. This does not execute the analysis or transfer local raw files.

tools.name: researchpilot_validate_specialist_receipt
tools.description: Validate a specialist execution receipt against its ResearchPilot request and authenticated project/context identity. This verifies identity, input digests, sample accounting, diagnostics and validation-state structure; it does not independently validate scientific correctness.

tools.name: researchpilot_save_work_artifact
tools.description: Save a substantive project-specific plan, interpretation, critique, draft, or specialist result as a non-canonical WORKING artifact. Use for durable ResearchPilot continuity; this never accepts a research decision or authorizes execution.

tools.name: gwriter_start_gwriter_edit
tools.description: Open a user-supplied Markdown draft in the external gWriter GPT Editor. Use this when the user wants to revise AI-written text in a full editing window.

tools.name: gwriter_get_gwriter_edit_result
tools.description: Check whether an external gWriter editing session is complete and, when complete, return the immutable revised Markdown.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: researchpilot_open_workspace · Private data: set_diagram_selection, submit_diagram_feedback, approve_report_chart, export_deck, get_pptx_workspace_status, save_pptx_document, list_pptx_documents, get_pptx_document, render_pptx_part, apply_pptx_patch, sync_pptx_document, export_pptx_document, delete_pptx_document, create_pptx_from_outline, analysis_match_propensity_scores, researchpilot_search_datasets, researchpilot_get_project_context, researchpilot_record_routing_feedback, researchpilot_prepare_specialist_execution · Public sink: submit_diagram_feedback, submit_chart_feedback, submit_deck_feedback · Destructive: render_methodiq_tool_directory, delete_pptx_document, analysis_run_classroom_demo, researchpilot_capabilities, researchpilot_prepare_specialist_execution.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: researchpilot_open_workspace · Private data: set_diagram_selection, submit_diagram_feedback, approve_report_chart, export_deck, get_pptx_workspace_status, save_pptx_document, list_pptx_documents, get_pptx_document, render_pptx_part, apply_pptx_patch, sync_pptx_document, export_pptx_document, delete_pptx_document, create_pptx_from_outline, analysis_match_propensity_scores, researchpilot_search_datasets, researchpilot_get_project_context, researchpilot_record_routing_feedback, researchpilot_prepare_specialist_execution · Public sink: submit_diagram_feedback, submit_chart_feedback, submit_deck_feedback · Destructive: render_methodiq_tool_directory, delete_pptx_document, analysis_run_classroom_demo, researchpilot_capabilities, researchpilot_prepare_specialist_execution

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
